description: Build a restriction map: sites, sites-by-enzyme, unique cutters and non-cutters. Named enzymes may be any of the 754 REBASE enzymes with a defined cut; with no names, enzyme_set picks the considered table ("common" = 39 by default, "rebase" = 754). sitesByEnzyme and nonCutters partition the considered enzyme set, keyed by canonical enzyme name. totalSites and uniqueCutters count CLEAVAGES, not recognition windows: every forward-strand record, plus every reverse-strand record whose backwards reading cuts other bonds — so a Type IIS enzyme such as BsaI is not a unique cutter merely because it has one forward-strand site, and the five enzymes whose two strand readings of one window cut different bonds (HauII, SgeI, MspJI, LpnPI, SgrTI) count twice for that window (B08 H32).

sequence.description: DNA sequence to map. IUPAC ambiguity codes are accepted anywhere in the sequence (N, R, Y, ...), so an N-containing contig or a soft-masked assembly can be mapped as it is: a site N matches any of the 15 IUPAC codes, every other site code matches only a concrete A/C/G/T base it expands to, and a character outside the 15 codes matches nothing — Biopython's own rule.

enzyme_names.description: Names of restriction enzymes to consider; empty to use every enzyme of enzyme_set.

topology.description: Linear (default) or Circular: whether the molecule is a linear fragment or a closed circle (plasmid).

enzyme_set.description: Enzyme table used when enzyme_names is empty: "common" (default; the 39 common laboratory enzymes) or "rebase" (all 754 REBASE enzymes with a defined cut). Case-insensitive; ignored when names are given.

methylation.description: Optional methylation-aware recognition (EMBOSS restrict -methylation semantics): "none" (default), "dam" (GmATC), "dcm" (mCmCAGG, mCmCTGG), "dam+dcm" or "emboss" (all five Emethylsites.dat entries incl. EcoKI). Case-insensitive. A recognition window containing a methylated base is NOT a site (a window rule, not an enzyme-specific sensitivity table; BamHI is blocked by Dam).

totalSites.description: Number of cleavages: every forward-strand record, plus every reverse-strand record whose backwards reading cuts other bonds.

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty

examples.name: All REBASE enzymes (no names, enzyme_set rebase)
